While taking this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests, such as kidney and liver function tests or HIV tests, may be conducted to monitor your health. 4. It is important to attend all scheduled laboratory and medical appointments during the course of treatment and for several months after completing the treatment. 5. If you miss a dose of this medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. 6. Store this medication in its original container at room temperature, away from light and moisture. 7. Do not store this medication in the bathroom, as the humidity can affect its stability. 8. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. 9.
